guldr.tagline: Your gold, in order. A local-first personal finance app.
guldr.problem: Finance apps ask for an account and send your spending to their servers. Guldr keeps everything on the phone: no account, no servers, nothing collected.
decisions: Money is stored as Int64 minor units plus an ISO 4217 code, never Double.
Domain logic lives in GuldrCore, a Swift package shared by the app and the widget and tested on macOS without a simulator.
Swift 6 strict concurrency and MVVM with @Observable view models.
Widgets read the SwiftData store read-only from the App Group.
guldr.outcome: v1.0 in TestFlight with a "Data Not Collected" privacy label. Budgets, analytics, widgets and a logging streak, with VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion throughout.
